name: KOTA-style: best 3 tricks + impression (DEFAULT)
description: Each trick scored 0-10 on Height, Extremity, Technicality, Execution (equal weights, mean). Best 3 tricks + one impression score per rider per heat. Heat total 0-40 (75% tricks / 25% impression). Based on the Red Bull King of the Air 2026 published format.
basedOn: Red Bull King of the Air 2026 format & qualifier judging criteria (redbull.com)

criteria.label: Height
criteria.help: Altitude of the jump relative to today's wind. Low height + extreme = low score.

criteria.label: Extremity
criteria.help: Power, kite angle, horizontal travel ('yank'), speed in and out, commitment.

criteria.label: Technicality
criteria.help: Difficulty: loop variations, rotations, board-offs, handle passes, grabs.

criteria.label: Execution
criteria.help: Control, stability, style, smoothness and a clean landing.

impression.label: Impression
impression.help: Whole-heat score: variety, risk, style, show, innovation, flow, both directions, landed vs crashed ratio.
